cwe_content.cwe: CWE-1021,Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames

candidate.Code: public class GrantCredentialsPermissionActivity extends Activity implements View.OnClickListener {
candidate.Reason: The class extends Activity and implements OnClickListener, indicating it handles UI interactions, but lacks explicit protection against overlay attacks such as setting window flags to prevent tapjacking.
The onCreate method is where the UI is set up, but it does not include code to set FLAG_SECURE or other window flags to restrict overlays, making it vulnerable to tapjacking attacks.
Setting the content view without applying security flags allows malicious overlays to intercept user taps on buttons like allow or deny.
The allow button is set to handle clicks, but without overlay protection, it can be targeted by tapjacking to trick the user into granting permissions.
Similarly, the deny button is vulnerable to overlay attacks, though exploitation might aim to trigger the allow action instead.
Adding views dynamically could be exploited if overlays are not restricted, but the primary vulnerability is in the button click handlers.

This method handles critical permission actions (allow/deny) based on user clicks, but the absence of overlay protection in the activity makes it susceptible to tapjacking, allowing malicious apps to trigger unintended actions.
